_comment: Approximate global mean/std priors for the 8 Open-Meteo variables used as the diffusion downscaler's target (see app/data/external_forecast.py: OPEN_METEO_VARIABLES). These are rough, order-of-magnitude sensible values -- NOT computed climatology -- good enough to get the diffusion process operating at a roughly-unit data scale (the actual requirement for Gaussian diffusion to behave sensibly) instead of mixing raw pressure (~1000) with raw wind direction (~0-360) with raw temperature (~20) in one tensor. Replace with real computed statistics once there's an actual archive to compute them from (see docs/TRAINING.md).
